latest_release.name: v4.2.0
latest_release.body:
## 🎉 Minor Release

This release includes minor version updates for all packages.

### 🔄 What's Changed

* fix(release): create releases with the GitHub Actions token by @fengmk2 in https://github.com/eggjs/egg/pull/6067
* docs(site): remove recruitment sections from homepages by @killagu in https://github.com/eggjs/egg/pull/6068
* fix(mock): avoid cluster HTTP port collisions in parallel tests by @killagu in https://github.com/eggjs/egg/pull/6069
* fix(mock): create HTTP server after app is ready by @fengmk2 in https://github.com/eggjs/egg/pull/6071
* chore(status): migrate egg-status into monorepo by @fengmk2 in https://github.com/eggjs/egg/pull/6070


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/eggjs/egg/compare/v4.1.2...v4.2.0
